newsitem.title: USA: Kensey says Angio-Seal indications expanded.
newsitem.headline: Kensey says Angio-Seal indications expanded.

text.p: Kensey Nash Corp said Monday the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has approved expanded indications for the company's Angio-Seal puncture closure device to allow for the device's use following a broader array of diagnostic and therapeutic procedures.

The company said the new indications will expand the use of the Angio-Seal device in conjunction with peripheral angiography, percutaneous transluminal angioplasty, coronary or peripheral stent placement and other interventional procedures.

"This approval is an extremely important step in broadening the potential market for the Angio-Seal," said Kensey Nash president and chief executive Joseph Kaufmann. "Our marketing partner, Sherwood Davis & Geck, will broaden the scope of its efforts to include the vast number of radiologists who perform a significant number of these procedures. As well,
cardiologists will enjoy additional flexibility in their ability to select the Angio-Seal device."
